# Alejandro Martínez-Mingo — Academic homepage

Official personal website of Alejandro Martínez-Mingo, Professor Ayudante Doctor at Universidad Nacional de Educación a Distancia (UNED), Faculty of Psychology, Department of Behavioral Sciences Methodology.

Main research areas: cognitive psychology, computational models of semantic representation, language models and construct validity, quantum-inspired cognitive modeling, behavioral science methodology.
